title: squadhq.yml
description: Agent Squad HQ configuration (schema version 1). Generated by squadhq.config.schema.

timezone.description: IANA zone; all schedules are local time

approvers.description: Users/teams who approve merges. Rendered to SQUADHQ_APPROVERS and projects[].merge.approvers; who may TRIGGER jobs is policies.triggers.allowed_associations.

operating_model.description: solo | team. RESERVED (server mode only): validated, not enforced in Actions mode.

dst.description: Which UTC offset crons are rendered for

bot.description: OPS GitHub App: routing, protocol markers, policy-approved merges (SQUADHQ_APP_CLIENT_ID / SQUADHQ_APP_PRIVATE_KEY / SQUADHQ_BOT_LOGIN)

agent_bot.description: AGENT GitHub App the coding agents run as; cannot merge, approve its own pushes or edit workflows (SQUADHQ_AGENT_APP_CLIENT_ID / SQUADHQ_AGENT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY / SQUADHQ_AGENT_BOT_LOGIN). Default <bot.app>-agent

single_app.description: Fallback: agents run as the ops App. Every auto, risk_based and trivial merge then needs an approver.

token_broker.description: Token-broker mode (ADR-0011): App installation tokens come from this broker in exchange for a GitHub Actions OIDC token, so no App private key is stored (SQUADHQ_TOKEN_BROKER / SQUADHQ_TOKEN_BROKER_AUDIENCE). Cannot be combined with single_app.

audience.description: OIDC audience the broker verifies; default the broker URL

id.description: Account id (slug): shown in summaries and the capacity state

secret.description: Secret holding this account's credential. Actions mode passes only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY[_1..5] / CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN[_1..5]; default <that>_<n>

pool.description: Coding-agent account pool: when one account hits its limit the next job uses the next one; the fleet pauses (or falls back) only when all are tripped. Pooling personal consumer subscriptions may violate the provider's terms.

pool_strategy.description: ordered = first untripped account; round_robin = rotate across untripped accounts

executor.description: Coding-agent executor. Actions mode runs claude-code; the others are RESERVED (server mode only): validated, not enforced in Actions mode.

per_project_usd.description: Project name (or default) -> USD. RESERVED (server mode only): validated, not enforced in Actions mode.

per_run_usd.description: Job -> USD per run. RESERVED (server mode only): validated, not enforced in Actions mode.

on_exceed.description: Actions mode always pauses at monthly_usd; downgrade and notify are RESERVED (server mode only): validated, not enforced in Actions mode.

items.description: github_issue[:owner/repo] | slack[:#channel] | email:addr | teams[:<url>] | webhook[:<url>] | discord[:<url>] | pagerduty[:<routing key>] | expo_push. Actions workflows post github_issue; other channels are rendered to SQUADHQ_NOTIFY_* for `python -m squadhq.notify` and server mode.

github_issue[:owner/repo] | slack[:#channel] | email:addr | teams[:<url>] | webhook[:<url>] | discord[:<url>] | pagerduty[:<routing key>] | expo_push. Actions workflows post github_issue; other channels are rendered to SQUADHQ_NOTIFY_* for `python -m squadhq.notify` and server mode.

agents.description: Switch agents on/off (rendered to SQUADHQ_DISABLED_AGENTS together with their job keys)

skills.description: Switch catalogue skills on/off by id (threat-modeler or threat_modeler)

edition.description: Skills above this tier are unavailable whatever the switches say

wip_limit.description: Open agent PRs per project (projects.json policies.wip_limit)

max_risk.description: Highest final risk that may auto-merge

require_security_agent.description: RESERVED (server mode only): validated, not enforced in Actions mode.

always_human.description: Areas that never auto-merge, by risk path category ('pii' has no detector yet)

strategy.description: merge_is_prod is the Actions behaviour; the others are RESERVED (server mode only): validated, not enforced in Actions mode.

budget_usd.description: Per-project budget. RESERVED (server mode only): validated, not enforced in Actions mode.

arch.description: Architecture gate: auto = runs when the pack's arch config exists in the repo; required = a missing config fails ci-gate; off = never

lint.description: Lint/format gate: auto = runs when a linter config exists (or the linter needs none); default = also use the pack's default config when the repo has none; off = never

changed_coverage.description: Changed-lines coverage against the pack's min_changed: enforce = a required ci-gate check (when min_changed > 0 and a report exists); report = summary only; off = not computed

quality.description: Quality gates run by stack CI and enforced by ci-gate
